critical.issue: AN entry is UNBALANCED by EXACTLY result_net (40485.01 EUR on Agathe FY 2026-2027). The '140100 Benefice reporte' credit line is added without any offsetting debit. Since result_net has already been distributed to owner 41x accounts via OD-REG-PROV/CHRG imputation, posting 140100 credit=result_net is a double-count. Fix options: (1) remove the 140100 posting entirely (result already in owner accounts), OR (2) post an offsetting 128 'Result de l'exercice' debit line to keep AN balanced, OR (3) alter OD-REG imputation so owner accounts don't absorb the result.

AUDIT VIOLATION: Guerit 41010016 in AN = 99.53 EUR CREDIT, but Bilan preview after_distribution shows Guerit = 26.95 EUR DEBIT (opposite sign). The AN does NOT reflect the after-repartition net balance. Root cause likely tied to bug #1: because 140100 absorbs 40485 outside of owner accounts, and equalization diff shifting on last owner (fiscal.py lines 237-243, 288-293), the owner balances in AN diverge from bilan preview. Requirement '(3) AUDIT : AN de l'annee suivante doit correspondre au solde net Apres repartition' is NOT met.

minor.issue: When sum(appels_fr_per_owner) != net class 7 balance (rounding or scope diff), the diff is silently absorbed by the LAST owner in the dict iteration order. This introduces non-deterministic drift on one arbitrary owner. Suggest documenting or pro-rata redistribution.

rca of the issue: close_fiscal_year fiscal.py flow: (1) Loads entries_periode, calls compute_regularization_per_owner → returns charges_per_owner[Guerit]=502.95, appels_fr_per_owner[Guerit]=1903.88. (2) Posts OD-REG-PROV: debit class 7 (net 55500), credit each owner 41x by their appels_fr. Diff between class 7 sum and appels_fr sum is EQUALIZED on last owner (silent shift). (3) Posts OD-REG-CHRG: debit each owner 41x by their charges_per_owner, credit class 6 (net 15015). Similar equalization. (4) Reloads all balances, generates AN for classes 1-5, adds 140100 Benefice reporte credit=result_net (40485). BUGS: (A) The 140100 credit has no debit counterpart → AN unbalanced by 40485. (B) After the two ODs, Guerit 41010016 net = (opening 199.86 as reserve on 41000016 not on 41010016) + provisions 1903.88 debit - payments 675.86 credit - OD-REG-PROV 1903.88 credit + OD-REG-CHRG 502.95 debit = actually should reflect the after-distribution balance BUT diverges due to equalization shift and/or scope mismatch. Bilan preview computes Guerit=26.95 while AN shows -99.53 (credit). The audit rule that AN == Bilan preview after_distribution is broken. FIX PATH: remove 140100 posting (or balance it with 128) AND ensure appels_fr_per_owner totals match class 7 net exactly to avoid equalization drift on last owner.
